**The brittleness**: hardcoded CSS selectors (`.job-description`, `.job-content`, etc.) that break whenever a site updates its class names.

**The fix**: Use `markitdown` (already installed) as the HTML-to-text converter. We:
1. Keep our existing `requests.get()` with all the custom headers and error handling
2. Keep the BeautifulSoup noise removal (script/style/nav/header/footer) — this makes markitdown output cleaner
3. Keep the JSON-LD/og:title metadata extraction for position name inference
4. Replace the fragile CSS selector → `get_text()` pipeline with a single markitdown conversion
5. Also apply markitdown to the `upload_file` HTML branch for consistency

The key insight: `markitdown` accepts a `io.BytesIO` stream with `StreamInfo(mimetype='text/html')` and produces clean, structured markdown preserving headings and lists — much more useful for LLM analysis downstream.

```
"""Test markitdown integration via pre-fetched Response object."""
import io
import requests
from markitdown import MarkItDown

sample_html = """<html>
<head><title>Senior Software Engineer at Acme Corp</title></head>
<body>
<nav>Navigation here</nav>
<header>Site header</header>
<main>
  <h1>Senior Software Engineer</h1>
  <p>Acme Corp - San Francisco, CA</p>
  <div class="job-description">
    <h2>About the Role</h2>
    <p>We are looking for a software engineer with 5+ years experience.</p>
    <h2>Responsibilities</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Design scalable systems</li>
      <li>Mentor junior engineers</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>Requirements</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Python, Go, or Rust experience</li>
      <li>Strong communication skills</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</main>
<footer>Footer content</footer>
</body>
</html>"""

# Build a real requests.Response populated with our HTML
response = requests.Response()
response.status_code = 200
response.headers['content-type'] = 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
response.url = 'https://example.com/jobs/123'
response._content = sample_html.encode('utf-8')

md = MarkItDown()
result = md.convert(response)
print("=== MARKITDOWN OUTPUT ===")
print(result.text_content)
print()
print(f"Length: {len(result.text_content)} chars")

```

```
"""Test markitdown integration via BytesIO stream."""
import io
from markitdown import MarkItDown
from markitdown._stream_info import StreamInfo

sample_html = """<html>
<head><title>Senior Software Engineer at Acme Corp</title></head>
<body>
<nav>Navigation here</nav>
<header>Site header</header>
<main>
  <h1>Senior Software Engineer</h1>
  <p>Acme Corp - San Francisco, CA</p>
  <div class="job-description">
    <h2>About the Role</h2>
    <p>We are looking for a software engineer with 5+ years experience.</p>
    <h2>Responsibilities</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Design scalable systems</li>
      <li>Mentor junior engineers</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>Requirements</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Python, Go, or Rust experience</li>
      <li>Strong communication skills</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</main>
<footer>Footer content</footer>
</body>
</html>"""

md = MarkItDown()

# Approach 1: BytesIO stream with StreamInfo
stream = io.BytesIO(sample_html.encode('utf-8'))
stream_info = StreamInfo(mimetype='text/html', charset='utf-8', url='https://example.com/jobs/123')
result = md.convert(stream, stream_info=stream_info)
print("=== APPROACH 1: BytesIO with StreamInfo ===")
print(result.text_content)
print(f"\nLength: {len(result.text_content)} chars")

```

```
"""Show what job_text looks like with JSON-LD prepended."""
import io
import json
from markitdown import MarkItDown
from markitdown._stream_info import StreamInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

html = """<html>
<head>
  <title>Senior Data Scientist | Acme Corp</title>
  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org/",
    "@type": "JobPosting",
    "title": "Senior Data Scientist",
    "description": "Lead machine learning initiatives across analytics, forecasting, and experimentation. Partner with engineering and product teams to deliver measurable impact.",
    "datePosted": "2026-03-15",
    "validThrough": "2026-05-01",
    "employmentType": "FULL_TIME",
    "hiringOrganization": {
      "@type": "Organization",
      "name": "Acme Corp"
    },
    "jobLocation": {
      "@type": "Place",
      "address": {
        "@type": "PostalAddress",
        "addressLocality": "San Francisco",
        "addressRegion": "CA"
      }
    }
  }
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <nav>Navigation we want stripped</nav>
  <main>
    <h1>Senior Data Scientist</h1>
    <p>Acme Corp — San Francisco, CA</p>
    <h2>About the Role</h2>
    <p>Lead machine learning initiatives across analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and platform delivery.</p>
    <h2>Responsibilities</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Build and maintain production ML models</li>
      <li>Mentor junior data scientists</li>
      <li>Collaborate with engineering on feature development</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>Requirements</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>5+ years experience in ML/data science</li>
      <li>Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch)</li>
    </ul>
  </main>
  <script>window.bad = "noise";</script>
</body>
</html>"""

# Simulate the route logic
soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

json_ld_blobs = []
for tag in soup.find_all('script', type='application/ld+json'):
    try:
        blob = json.loads(tag.string or '')
        if isinstance(blob, dict):
            json_ld_blobs.append(blob)
    except Exception:
        pass

for noise in soup(['script', 'style', 'nav', 'header', 'footer', 'noscript']):
    noise.decompose()

stream = io.BytesIO(str(soup).encode('utf-8'))
stream_info = StreamInfo(mimetype='text/html', charset='utf-8', url='https://example.com/job')
html_text = MarkItDown().convert(stream, stream_info=stream_info).text_content

if json_ld_blobs:
    blobs_md = "\n\n".join(json.dumps(b, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) for b in json_ld_blobs)
    job_text = (
        "## Structured Job Data (JSON-LD)\n\n"
        + blobs_md
        + "\n\n---\n\n## Page Content\n\n"
        + html_text
    )
else:
    job_text = html_text

print(job_text)
print(f"\n\nTotal length: {len(job_text)} chars")

```
